role: CI gate: every .swift file under Emuqu, EmuquTests, EmuquUITests and the watch app is referenced in project.pbxproj (or lives in a synchronized root group), and no basename appears twice in Sources phases.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd. PROJECT=$1 or Emuqu.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj; roots = remaining args or four defaults. SYNCED_ROOTS from PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup `path =` values. For each file: synced -> count; else grep `/* <basename> */` in pbxproj or record missing. Missing -> exit 1. Duplicates: `uniq -d` over `<name>.swift in Sources */,` occurrences -> exit 1. Else clean with counts.

flags.text: Membership is tested by basename comment text anywhere in pbxproj, so a file whose PBXFileReference exists but is in no Sources phase, or that shares a basename with a registered file, passes. The duplicate check would also flag a file legitimately compiled into two targets.
Missing roots are skipped (`[[ -d ]] || continue`) and a missing project file only makes grep print errors. Run from /tmp it prints 'clean. 0 Swift files ... are in a target' and exits 0.

units.does: Returns 1 when there are no synchronized roots; returns 0 if the file path starts with any synchronized root path + '/', else 1.
